description: This file defines an interface named OutboundSignal representing an outbound signal in a connectivity model. It includes nested interfaces for mappable signals, mapped signals, and collections of mapped signals, along with JSON field definitions related to the signal data.

classes.name: OutboundSignal
classes.description: An interface representing an outbound signal sent from Ditto to an external target, including source and targets, with methods to convert to JSON.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.Mappable
classes.description: An extension of OutboundSignal that includes payload mapping information used in message mapping.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.Mapped
classes.description: An extension of OutboundSignal that involves the mapped external message and the adapted protocol message.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.MultiMapped
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of outbound signals mapped from the same source signal, including methods to access the first, list of mapped signals, and sender.

classes.name: OutboundSignal.JsonFields
classes.description: A class containing JSON field definitions used within OutboundSignal, such as source, targets, and headers.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source signal that originated the outbound signal.

methods.name: getTargets
methods.description: Returns the list of targets authorized to receive and subscribe to the outbound signal.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns additional fields of an enriched signal, if any.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the outbound signal into a JSON object including only non-hidden fields, optionally considering schema version and field selector.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns the payload mapping used to map the signal to the target.

methods.name: getExternalMessage
methods.description: Returns the external message mapped from the outbound signal.

methods.name: getAdaptable
methods.description: Returns the Ditto protocol message after adaptation.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first mapped outbound signal.

methods.name: getMappedOutboundSignals
methods.description: Returns a list of outbound signals mapped from the same source signal.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns an Optional ActorRef representing the sender of the original signal.
